messages:
alejandra: opening a tiny PR to add a Private/VPC migration quicknotes page. includes MTU tips, a short PKCS#11 example, sha256 checksum for air-gapped bundles, and a minimal JS proxy snippet. need 1 reviewer.

mike: please separate installer vs runtime ports in the checklist. keep it short.

jin: replacement HSM link: https://hsm-vendor.example.com/linux-pkcs11-guide. pkcs11 example:

# /etc/redwood/hsm.conf
pkcs11_library = /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
slot_label = "redwood-hsm-slot"

emily: checksum snippet (sha256):
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
# on target
dos2unix bundle.sha256 || true
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256

mike: ack. i'll review port list + MTU repro later.

docs-bot: CI started for branch docs/private-migration-quicknotes (build #901)
